description: Call this when the user asks about funding arbitrage, funding rate differences between exchanges, or delta-neutral carry trades. Compares funding across every venue on the board, from Binance, OKX and Bybit to Hyperliquid, dYdX and the smaller perp venues fed by the venue snapshot, for 12 major perps and returns the best long/short venue per symbol with gross and net annualized APR (net of taker fees and weekly rebalance cost). Each row lists its first 5 venue legs; pass symbol for every leg of one perp.

symbol.description: Optional. One perp, e.g. BTCUSDT or BTC: its row with every venue leg.

name: get_funding_arbitrage
title: Cross-exchange funding arbitrage opportunities
